title: Year Over Year
description: Compare year-over-year performance for a route or corridor across speed, travel time, and delay.
_note: Reconstructed via --from-page 2210500. This is the template the whole 'no fixed dates, ever' round's status claim turned out false for most directly: the archive says 6 individual-year comps + 24 orphaned sections were deleted and the survivors repointed to Current Year/1-2 Years Ago/Trailing 3 Years — but the live route array still had all 10 original frozen-year routes (2016-2024 + a 2016-2022 span), zero dateFormula anywhere, and graph_count/counts_label were stale (said '21 graphs', the live page has 9 real ones). SOME section cleanup evidently did happen (9 real sections survive, not 21+), but the route-level fix never did. Applied the real 4-comp reduction here, matching the archive's own documented target exactly (Current Year / 1 Year Ago / 2 Years Ago / Trailing 3 Years, formula year-2year->3year for the trailing window) — every AVL Graph/Map/InfoBox/RouteCompare panel re-pointed at whichever of the 4 comps its own title names; two graphs referencing the old 7-year span (comp-8, itself already orphaned on the live page before this pass) re-pointed at Trailing 3 Years as the closest equivalent.
